decision_audited: Whether the four native 0.25-Myr paired coarse-grid smokes and the cancellation-aware validator correction are sufficient to authorise four fresh 50-Myr coarse reflective/outflow controls, conditional on a fresh target revalidation gate; the production-matched control remains excluded.
verdict_scope: The four fresh 50-Myr coarse reflective/outflow controls are cleared for launch with the frozen r1 physics stage and r2 full wrapper. This does not support or authorise a production-matched control, and it does not prejudge the full-run scientific outcome.
conditions_before_full_launch: A new immutable analysis overlay must pass target revalidation with scheduler exit 0.

The fresh gate must report 38 budget tests passed with zero failures, errors or skips; four unchanged native smoke receipts; four measured MPI exit-zero records; four corrected budget receipts; and two paired-identity receipts.

Cross-node stability may ignore only the NFS client-specific device number, and only when path, resolved path, inode, size, mtime and ctime match, a retained SHA-256 exists, a fresh full-file SHA-256 matches it, and before/after live stats are identical.
The gate must bind the four CSV ledgers directly as well as the fresh budget receipts, native receipts, measured execution records, pair receipts, stage manifest, overlay manifest and test XML.
The full wrapper must revalidate the frozen stage and overlay manifests and every gate-evidence hash before creating a fresh full-run directory.
No result may be generalized to the stretched production grid; full-run boundary attribution requires residual and conversion-repair terms to remain materially below the paired contrast.

capture_integrity.important_limit: The compact capture does not contain the eight approximately 5.77-GB HDF5 snapshots. Their full hashes, native scans and integrated-storage checks are preserved in the four source receipts, but this local audit did not rescan the raw HDF5 arrays.

signed_flux_arithmetic_audit.functional_change: Use positive minus signed-negative transport, the sum of absolute traffic, as the conditioning scale for net versus positive-plus-negative consistency.

failing_record.interpretation: The discrepancy is approximately 26 binary64 epsilons of gross traffic, consistent with separately accumulated and MPI-reduced signed and partitioned sums; scaling by the cancelled net was ill-conditioned.

signed_flux_arithmetic_audit.negative_control: A manufactured inconsistency of 1e-6 of gross traffic remains rejected.

budget_and_materiality_audit.interpretation: At 0.25 Myr the paired hydro-energy contrasts are almost entirely reconstructed by measured boundary transport, with reported gravity and conversion terms small and unexplained hydro residual differences below 2.4e-8 of the contrast. This supports the diagnostic mechanism but is not evidence of 50-Myr stability or production-grid behavior.

cross_node_device_anomaly.observation: The same NFS-backed stage exposed different st_dev values on different compute clients, so the first target revalidation failed before scientific budget checks despite unchanged retained receipt identities.
cross_node_device_anomaly.scientific_assessment: st_dev is client mount metadata, not content identity. Ignoring it without compensation would weaken provenance; accepting only that mismatch while requiring a full retained SHA-256 match and exact stable remaining metadata is stronger content evidence and is acceptable.

ranked_threats.threat: The original group-reflective PBS and first cross-node revalidation exited nonzero for separate analysis-layer reasons.
ranked_threats.resolution: The preserved r2 overlay corrected only those two conditioned checks and target job 872682 completed F/0 with all source-bound evidence verified.

ranked_threats.threat: A 0.25-Myr coarse uniform-grid smoke cannot establish 50-Myr stability or behavior on the stretched production grid.
ranked_threats.resolution: Interpret the four full runs only as coarse boundary controls; keep the production-matched control held and qualify all inference.

ranked_threats.threat: Conversion repair is nonzero and potential closure is diagnostic rather than an exact acceptance gate.
ranked_threats.resolution: At 50 Myr require conversion-repair and residual contributions to remain materially below the pair contrast; diagnose rather than relax thresholds if they do not.

ranked_threats.threat: The compact local capture omits raw HDF5 arrays.
ranked_threats.resolution: Retain and recheck their source receipts and live identities in the target gate; preserve the full recorded hashes.

residual_uncertainty: Even after a successful fresh gate, the smoke evidence establishes implementation identity, numerical accounting and short-run feasibility only. The 50-Myr coarse trajectories may reveal accumulated drift, nonlinear boundary interactions, larger conversion repair or different timestep histories. Neither a null nor non-null coarse contrast determines the production-grid counterfactual.
